principal_source.title: From Classical to Quantum Shannon Theory
principal_source.edition: Cambridge University Press second-edition prepublication draft, arXiv:1106.1445v8 (2019-07-14), 774 PDF pages; substantive body and both appendices pp. 1–745 read, bibliography/index not read cover-to-cover.

principal_source.reading_reported: Full substantive text and appendices of the current v8 source read; complete reads of Devetak (2004) and Portmann–Renner (2014) also reported. Final local article inventory and evidence ledger received.
principal_source.limitations: All inspected entropy/capacity statements are finite dimensional and asymptotic i.i.d. product models unless a stronger condition is explicitly stated. Quantum DPI, strong subadditivity, regularization, and nonadditivity require separate proofs; classical fidelity/trace-distance DPI does not supply relative-entropy DPI. Quantum QKD security uses an abort-aware ideal/real protocol model, authentication assumptions, and a distinct correctness condition.
